WITH prepared_meals AS (
    SELECT p."name" AS product_name
    FROM "products" p
    JOIN "foodtypes" f ON p."foodtypeid" = f."foodtypeid"
    WHERE f."typename" = 'prepared meals'
      AND p."best_before" = '10.11.2018'
),
takeaway_products AS (
    SELECT p."name" AS product_name
    FROM "products" p
    JOIN "foodtypes" f ON p."foodtypeid" = f."foodtypeid"
    WHERE f."typename" = 'takeaway'
      AND p."best_before" = '10.11.2018'
)

SELECT
    'prepared meals' AS category,
    pm.product_name
FROM prepared_meals pm

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'takeaway' AS category,
    tp.product_name
FROM takeaway_products tp;

    CASE
        WHEN ft."typename" = 'prepared meals' THEN 'prepared meal'
        WHEN p."best_before" = '10.11.2018' THEN 'takeaway product'
    END AS product_type
FROM
    "products" p
LEFT JOIN
    "foodtypes" ft ON p."dining" = ft."foodtypeid"

    ft."typename" = 'prepared meals'

WITH ny_hotels AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    WHERE LOWER(c."name") = 'new york'
),
swimming_pool_hotels AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'swimming pool'
    AND h."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM ny_hotels)
),
hot_tub_hotels AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'hot tub'
    AND h."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM ny_hotels)
)
SELECT
    'Swimming pool hotels' AS "feature_type",
    sph."name" AS "hotel_name"
FROM swimming_pool_hotels sph
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Hot tub hotels' AS "feature_type",
    hth."name" AS "hotel_name"
FROM hot_tub_hotels hth;

    its."name";

SELECT "full_name" AS chef_name
FROM (
    SELECT "full_name" FROM "executive_chef"
    UNION
    SELECT "full_name" FROM "sous_chef"
) AS all_chefs
ORDER BY "full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
323:
SELECT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    c."fullname" AS customer_name,
    r."customer_reviews" AS review_text,
    r."number_of_stars" AS stars_assigned
FROM
    "reviews" r
JOIN
    "hotels" h ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
JOIN
    "customers" c ON r."customerid" = c."customerid"
ORDER BY
    h."name", c."fullname";
325:
SELECT
    h."hotelid",
    h."name" AS "hotel_name",
    COALESCE(AVG(r."number_of_stars"), 0) AS "average_stars"
FROM
    "hotels" h
LEFT JOIN
    "reviews" r ON h."hotelid" = r."hotelid"
GROUP BY
    h."hotelid", h."name";
329:
SELECT h."opening_year"
FROM "hotels" h
JOIN "rooms" r ON h."hotelid" = r."hotelid"
WHERE r."rate" = (
    SELECT MAX("rate")
    FROM "rooms"
)
LIMIT 1;
332:
WITH max_rate_hotel AS (
    SELECT
        r."hotelid",
        MAX(r."rate") AS max_rate
    FROM
        "rooms" r
    GROUP BY
        r."hotelid"
    ORDER BY
        max_rate DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    h."opening_year",
    h."opening_month"
FROM
    "hotels" h
JOIN
    max_rate_hotel mrh ON h."hotelid" = mrh."hotelid";
